purpose: Source-change context for the V2.5 audit quote; not a deployment attestation or a security review.

metrics.normalization: Tool-defined function-header collapse followed by nonblank/noncomment JavaScript-mode SLOC counting. Counts are formatting-sensitive, include interfaces and shared declarations, and are not logical statement counts.

normalization: Discard comments, locations, ranges and tokens.
Canonicalize uint/int/byte type aliases to uint256/int256/bytes1.
Compare top-level declarations and non-state-variable contract members by declaration identity, ignoring order.
Preserve inheritance, state-variable order and initializers, struct and enum member order, bodies, modifiers, parameter names, data locations and assembly flags.
Compare imports separately; record pragmas separately. All unchanged-declaration files have identical imports, while their compiler range becomes an exact 0.8.25 pin.
syntax.hashEncoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace and unescaped Unicode; arrays retain the normalized declaration order.

method.functions: Count explicit function/modifier definitions with bodies, including constructors and empty implementations; exclude abstract declarations, inherited-only members and compiler-generated getters. Match whole normalized definitions. Cross-file matches count current definitions and may reuse one predecessor more than once. Exact-body-only matches with changed headers are separate.

compiler.sources: Git snapshots and imported dependencies resolved at each revision’s own gitlink commits.
compiler.abiComparison: Compare complete ABI entries, including outputs, names, errors and events, after sorting root entries.
compiler.storageComparison: Remove AST IDs and expand compiler type references into structural definitions; preserve slots, offsets, labels and member order.

limits: No behavioral equivalence, bytecode equality, deployed identity, audit coverage or review-effort percentage is implied.
Unchanged bodies can execute in changed callers, inheritance, storage, libraries or external-contract context.
Compiler storageLayout omits immutables, transient state and manually assigned assembly storage slots; equal empty layouts are not evidence of equivalent behavior.
New paths include extracted and copied code; modified predecessor files include retained code. Net SLOC growth is not changed SLOC.
The V2.5 audit packet excludes non-AccessList provider implementations; this comparison does not expand its scope.
